Episode 155: Again, To Lafralarosa (2)
There wasn't a single member of the family in a position to 'inform' Chiron and Rosa.
Rosa didn't take Jin's remark about leaving again as soon as he arrived negatively.
Rather, she felt a sense of anticipation in his confident attitude.
Luna's presence was also seen.
Luna had also unilaterally informed the family that she would give up her position as the head of the family.

However, Luna informed them of her intention to give up the position of head, while Jin's intention was the opposite. To Rosa, every action Jin took was solely for the purpose of swallowing the family whole.

"You've just come back, and you're telling me interesting stories as soon as you see me. You must know how chaotic the family is right now. It seems you're lacking a little self-awareness as the highest-ranked member of the family."
Contrary to her words, her tone was not scolding. Jin responded with a light smile.
"While I was receiving intensive healing in the Holy Kingdom, I found out the usage and creator of the items I obtained in the Sota Desert."
"What were they?"
"As the prophet said, they were indeed items that could change the tide of war. The machine is a core component of a teleportation device."
He deliberately said 'teleportation device' instead of 'spacetime device'. The two concepts, although seemingly similar, were clearly different, and there was no need to share everything with Rosa.
"You've obtained this information through Aria Hister."
Jin wasn't taken aback by Rosa's confident voice. Valeria being with him was now nothing more than an open secret among the major powers.
"Yes."
Capturing Valeria and bringing her to the Garden of Swords was a regular mission for the high-ranking members.
Rosa didn't scold him about it either.
By causing Joshua to fall, she had already granted Jin a certain level of freedom. Jin had not crossed the line she had set.
"The creator of that item is Lokia Ganesto, a former Ten Knight of Runcandel."
"… Lokia Ganesto?"

"Yes. Until recently, Lokia Ganesto was forgotten due to Zipple's manipulation of history. As Zipple's power weakens and the curse of the family fades, the hidden history of the old Runcandel is gradually being revealed."
Ganesto.
She had been aware of that name long before the power of the story faded.
"If what you're saying is true, then the teleportation device and the shipbuilding technology are already a thousand-year-old technology, and the family had them stolen by Zipple at some point."
"Are there no records related to that in the family?"

"None. Even if there were, a record of the time when the items were lost would be meaningless, and if it was a record that informed how to use the items immediately, you would have had to attribute them to the family right away."
What was important to Rosa was not the discovery of lost history, but immediate victory and survival.
Jin believed that he could never win unless he restored the prestige of old Runcandel, but Rosa didn't think so.
"The item is still unusable."
"So, how much more time do you need?"
"I don't know. The reason I'm leaving Inse is to complete the item with the help of my brothers."
Jin's reason for leaving for Lafralarosa was not just for personal achievement.
A flying ship that uses a crystal heart as its power source. When he first saw Zipple's mass-produced fleet in the Sota Desert, Jin had dreamed of such a thing.
'If Master and Lord Kwall complete the spacetime device and summon the brothers to Inse through it, it won't end as a mere fanciful story.'
It was already guaranteed that it was theoretically possible, as Kwall had seen the crystal heart in Jin's chest.
"Even if it takes time, can you definitely complete it with the help of the Nomads?"
"I can't guarantee it."
"Not yet, don't know, can't guarantee. You keep saying things that don't suit you. That's not why I gave you autonomy."

"It's no different from the acting head of the family delaying the decision whether it would be better to negotiate with the prophet or not. And in my opinion, I think the acting head of the family has already once resisted the temptation of the prophet at the Sword Emperor's Palace."
"Please restore the second generation. Then the prophet will lend you power."
"Fine, don't disappoint me. Get lost. If any of my 12th generation comrades are dead when I return to the family, you will be executed immediately."
Jin hadn't heard the conversation between Rosa, Myu, and Anne during the war, but he was certain that the prophet had proposed something to Rosa. He was also certain that Rosa had rejected it.
'If my mother had made a deal with the prophet then, the situation would have changed before Lon Kyung reached Genesis. Joshua would be restored by now.'
Joshua is still locked in the underground prison.
And the reason Rosa rejected Myu and Anne's suggestion at that desperate moment was because she knew that the prophet ultimately had no choice but to 'symbiotically' coexist with Runcandel.

If Runcandel was really about to be destroyed by Gliyak, she calculated that the prophet would have borrowed power on his own even if she refused. The prophet had no other choice, even for the realization of the prophecy.
"I haven't disappointed the acting head of the family very much. So, please trust me."
"Youngest."
"Yes."
"Are you so afraid of me negotiating with the prophet? To the point where you need to beg me."
Only then could Rosa realize what Jin wanted to tell her.
"It may seem like begging. Then this time, I will ask the acting head of the family. Acting head of the family,..."
How much time do you have left?
Jin continued in a heavy voice. What he was worried about was Rosa's 'demonic transformation'.
There was no way for Jin to verify how quickly the chaos that had stained Rosa was eroding her.
'My mother was definitely exposed to the most immense level of chaos.'
When Lon sacrificed his life to stop Gliyak's self-destruction, naturally, the ones who bore the most aftermath were Rosa and Kelliark.
Kelliark was able to protect himself to some extent using the demon stone as a shield, but all that was left for Rosa was just a sword and the family members waiting for death behind her.
The reason she seemed to move fine despite being exposed to more chaos than Kelliark, unlike him who was a living artifact, was due to her pure power.
Demonic transformation.
Jin had experienced the greatest chaos in Gliyak's subspace more than anything else.
He knew well how that power could drive people into madness and make them go crazy.

Even Lon would have become a monster without being able to overcome the demonic transformation if it wasn't for Jin and Dante. Jin expected that Rosa was also going through the same process as he and Lon did back then.
No, he was certain. In Jin's eyes, it was clear that Rosa was resisting the demonic transformation every moment to maintain her composure.
"You seem to take me a little lightly."
Rosa didn't show anger this time either.
Because she couldn't be sure if the anger that had just risen was entirely her own. If the influence of the demonic transformation was mixed in even a little, she had to suppress it.
"Just as I did just now, please tell me honestly, acting head of the family. If it's very urgent, I can't leave trusting you."
The two stared into each other's eyes.

Both were looking at each other as enemies. Although they shared the goal of Runcandel's survival and prosperity, the paths they were walking were so different. Different enough to become enemies even while running towards the same place.
"If my answer is negative, does it mean you'll change your plan?"

"Going to the brothers of Lafralarosa is constant. Because it's the only way to complete the items. However, if the remaining time for the acting head of the family is shorter than I expected, I plan to cut off the prophet's henchmen before I leave."
"The prophet's henchmen?"

"The 8th and 9th generations. After Joshua's final battle, I am sure that those two have become the new messengers of the prophet. If we kill them, the prophet will also need some time to recover. Then, naturally, the opportunities for the prophet to get closer to the acting head of the family will decrease. Even while I'm away."
Jin spoke with conviction.

It was just a suspicion that Myu and Anne became the prophet's messengers. Besides, even if they were killed, it was uncertain whether the prophet would be so damaged that they would need a recovery period, and Jin had no real intention of killing them.
Even if it is proven that Myu and Anne are the prophet's henchmen, there would be a lot of information to find out through them.
"Even if Myu and Anne become the prophet's henchmen, as you say. Would I just watch that happen?"
"I will deal with those two, even if it dries up the acting head of the family and the entire family."
In a way, Jin was warning Rosa based on mere suspicion.
The reason he could do this was because Rosa and Runcandel were not in a position to crush Jin and Vamel's alliance with a single word as they had before the war.

"And the prophet might not have the power to stop me right away, even if they know about the family. If they had such power, they would have already taken control of the family when Joshua was around. It's true that the prophet wields special abilities through chaos, but there is definitely something wrong with them."
Like King Orgal of Kinzelo, for example.
Jin swallowed his words and smiled.

"Also, I will reveal the existence of the prophet to the world as a reason for killing them. Now that everyone hates chaos because of Gliyak. If the fact that our family has been conspiring with a chaotic being since the past, and it comes from my mouth."
"Enough."
Jin stopped talking.
"You're saying that you can pour sewage water into the family whenever I negotiate with the prophet, even when you're gone. After all, your people are here, outside Lafralarosa."
"That's right."
Rosa, who had been glaring at Jin since the mention of killing Myu and Anne, finally burst into laughter at that point.
"Now you're talking like yourself."
"I'll take it as a compliment."

"I understand your notification. I will be more careful in my calculations, so put down your worries about my demonic transformation. However, don't forget that a threat is only valuable until it is executed."
"Of course."
"Three years."
Looking at her black-stained wrist, Rosa said.
"Assuming that my demonic transformation continues at the same speed as it is now, I should be able to endure for about three years. Make sure to come back within that time."
